cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tell your dad I failed the course too, so you aren't alone. When I face mine, you owe me the same.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad frightens me. I can't promise that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get us through this call first. You can pick when we tell mine; I still need you beside me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I just wait in the car when you tell him?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come in for 'I failed too', then you can leave. I'll handle his questions.
